Key design decisions recorded (against the contract + L3 §4.6, disclosed):

- **Additive sqitch change `camera_site_derivation`.** The contract's
  "schema changes require new sqitch files" clause governs: the v3 link
  vocabulary cannot ride `same_as` alone — `camera_site_match.relation_type`
  widens to `derived_from` (a C0/C1/C2 collapse carrying the shared
  `site_id` column), `possible_duplicate` (every inferential match, never
  clustered), `same_as` (B5-certified/human edges), `cannot_link`; NEW
  append-only `camera_site_census` (one GQ-23 row per completed run:
  failures + `demote_next_run` + GQ-25 count) and `camera_site_demotion`
  (`run_key,token,tier,reason` — the set the NEXT run consumes; PK
  conflicts = +0). `sig_materialize` SELECT+INSERT both; `sig_export`
  SELECT (the camera-site machinery stays off the `public_read_allowlist`
  surface — caught by its exact-set contract test). `merged_into` stays
  unwritten (ADR-105 §6); no UPDATE/DELETE anywhere.
- **C0/C1/C2/P vocabulary on the emitted tier labels:** `C0:duplicate_target`,
  `C1:namespaced_copy`, `C2:position_matched_copy`, `P3…P5:*`; ruleset
  `version = "3"` (`SIG-RECON-002`: a versioned ruleset — the v2/v3.1
  interim outputs supersede, never rewrite).
- **C1 verbatim:** same normalised ref + same declared `id_namespace`
  (never `undeclared`) + both sources in ONE declared copy lineage +
  the ref unique in each source's record set + distance ≤
  `copy_tolerance_m` (1.0 m working value pending M-3).
- **C2 verbatim (Q-L3-6 = a):** declared lineage with documentary
  evidence (a `mirror`/`derived` kind declaration carrying non-empty
  `evidence`) + measured overlap ≥ 0.9 (`c2_min_overlap`) + bijective
  within 5 m (`unique_within_colocation`) + ≤ `copy_tolerance_m` + no
  attribute conflict. `c2_enabled` is a ruleset flag — a future
  operator flip to the alternative lands as data.
- **Soft conflicts → P, even on a collapse-tier pair** (the P
  enumeration names "soft conflicts" verbatim; attribute *differences*
  on a C1 copy are recorded in the collapse evidence, never silently).
- **GQ-25 strict form:** a would-be cluster holding two distinct
  normalised refs inside ONE declared namespace refuses
  (`cluster_constraint:origin_distinct`) — the origin lists those ids
  as distinct rows. Over-refusal stays in the conservative direction
  (over-counting, never under-counting).
- **GQ-23 census:** an independent re-verification pass
  (`derivation_census`) re-checks every applied C0/C1/C2 collapse from
  the record data + re-counts GQ-25 violations over final clusters;
  failures append per-(lineage,tier) `demote_next_run` keys to the run
  summary; `materialize_camera_sites` reads the LATEST completed run's
  demotion keys and passes `demoted_collapses` to the next resolve —
  a demoted collapse surfaces as a `possible_duplicate` with reason
  `possible_duplicate:census_demoted`.
- **`axis_swap_suspected` guard (dep P35.16):** a record carrying a
  current `geometry_defect=axis_swap` claim is never a collapse input —
  unless its current coordinate pair is itself the `axis_swap`
  correction (the defect then stands resolved; the claim remains as
  the immutable marking).
- **Count intervals:** `count_intervals` emits upper = post-collapse N
  and lower = clusters if every `possible_duplicate` link within the
  declared distance (`near_max_m`, the GQ-10 25 m bound) merged —
  nationally and per dossier (jurisdiction key); the run re-derives,
  never assumes the design's illustration.
- **`device_kind` soft conflict:** both records declare technology and
  their declared classes differ → `device_kind` in `soft_conflict_fields`
  (never a silent hard merge; incompatible classes stay never-candidates
  upstream of this).

## Phase 3 — self-review

Two passes over the diff:

1. **Found and fixed in this pass:** `clopper_pearson_lower` bisected the
   wrong direction (returned ~0 always — the new bound test caught it);
   `_RECORDS_SQL`'s new `correction_reason` column broke
   `camera_site_review.read_observation`'s 7-tuple unpack (the review
   suite caught it); `sig_read_public` SELECT on the new tables violated
   the `public_read_allowlist` exact-set contract (its contract test
   caught it — `sig_export` + `sig_materialize` now mirror the post-P34.25
   camera_site_* surface); the run ledger's stale "no schema change"
   claim and `live_verification=true` posture corrected (the migration
   IS a sqitch change; the AR-3 window is closed at verify time so the
   leg queues, never claims).
2. **Architecture pass:** derivation links carry `site_id` (the cluster
   root subject id — never a minted entity, `merged_into` unwritten);
   possible duplicates carry `site_ids` + basis + distance + reason;
   every inferential match is review-only by construction (`auto` =
   collapse tiers by census waiver + B5-certified tiers only); the
   demotion set is a run-key input so a consumed demotion mints a new
   run, never silently reuses one; census failures demote per
   (lineage-or-source, tier) — a stale declaration collapses for at most
   one run.
